about: Graded relevance judgments, by plugin name, for every query of Queries.json. 2: the plugin does the task; 1: partly, for one region or data source only, or as a side feature. Any plugin not listed is judged not relevant. Judged by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from each plugin's name, description, about and tags, on 2026-11-12, blind to which system retrieved it: candidates were pooled from the top results of every compared system and language (pool lists below), then completed by a pattern search over the whole catalogue for plugins no system retrieved. Review and correct freely; the evaluation reads this file.
